about: R9 PALETTE-MAP (PLAN-P §4.2): every colour literal of the app's look, classified into a family and mapped onto the D1 'Burrow Works' ladder keeping L* and relative chroma (art-direction.md §7.3). A5 CODEMOD applies the 'edits' (exclusive window), re-runs art_batch --svg for the generator constants, then captures + copygate. Regenerate with `tools/palette_map.py build` right before applying: offsets are exact for the tree whose file shas are in 'tree'; `apply --to DIR` refuses a drifted file.
rule: L*: kept (lmode keep) or carried along the D1 token ladder (lmode ladder: plank, exit-accent); C*: the colour's own chroma x the family's D1/today chroma ratio at that L*; hue: the D1 ladder hue at that L* + kh x the colour's hue offset; chroma reduced into sRGB if needed. Moves < ΔE00 1.0 are 'keep (sub-JND)'.

chrome-blue.what: blue chrome: glossy button faces/rims/light edges, panel frames/fields/bumpers/rivets, navy outlines and text outlines, royal page backgrounds, HUD pills/panels/timer, nav bar + raised tab, toggles, blue labels and tints
chrome-blue.d1: the D1 teal chrome ladder (art-direction §3.1 'UI colour shift'): face #17B3A3, light edge #7FEADB, rim #0B8A83 -> #075E5E, outline #053F43, page #155158, HUD pill #D4F4EC, HUD digits #0B5A55

go-green.what: the green 'go' family: Play/Resume/Continue pills, level plate, toggles ON, booster squircles, plus/check icons, the claw bar fill, the 'me' row, green text outlines
go-green.d1: the D1 sunflower-orange CTA ladder (art §3.1; OD7 default): face #FFB422 -> #FF9A12, light edge #FFE08A, rim #D06A06 -> #9E4A00, outline #6B2E00, label outline #8A3F00

plank.what: the popup title ribbon (yellow arched banner + orange shade + brown outlines), its title-text outline, the shop's yellow section plate
plank.d1: the honey-wood plank ladder (art §3.1 title ribbon: #F0B86A -> #D9913E, rim #9E5F24, label #6A3510; timber #7E4E27). LADDER mode: keeping L* made the ribbon a pale peach (R1 palette mock), so L* follows the plank tokens

danger-red.what: danger / Hard reds: Quit pill, close X disc, count badges, Hard plate/tab/ribbon, red text and outlines
danger-red.d1: the D1 danger ladder (art §3.1: face #F2553F -> #DC3A26, rim #A82314); red stays red (ΔE00 ~4, generic)

cream.what: cream insets, card bevels and borders, toggle wells, warm light text fills and bands
cream.d1: the D1 cream (art §3.1 panel inset #FFF3DF, border #D8A878)

ink-brown.what: dark warm inks: panel labels and text outlines on cream and orange
ink-brown.d1: the D1 label brown (art §3.1 label #6A3510; STYLE §B panel label #632201 today)

berry.what: purple / violet / magenta chrome: purple buttons, Super Hard plate/tab/ribbon/tag, purple frames and outlines, the shop's purple section plate, event page purples
berry.d1: a berry ladder from the boss's pink fur (art §3.0/§3.1 boss ladder #FFA8C8 ... #B22470): D1 has no violet, and the violet arrow sign / buttons are the original's secondary colour

exit-accent.what: the board's exit colour and vacated dots (engine colours)
exit-accent.d1: tangerine exit #FF8F1F, dots #FFDDB0 (art §3.1). R7 BOARD-UI owns the 2 engine colours (PLAN-P §4.2)

loading-base.what: the launch-screen background and the Loading base colour (a lavender/mauve under the Loading art)
loading-base.d1: R4 LOADING sets it from the new Loading backdrop; reference = D1 rock #4E7F86 at the same L*

excluded.neutral: white / black / grey (CIELAB C* < 4): generic, unchanged
excluded.gold-accent: saturated gold / yellow / orange accents outside the title ribbon (coins, stars, prize and claim titles, streak flames, claw bar palette): generic genre colours and already inside D1's warm ladder (hat #FFCB2F, lantern #FFCF6B, vest #FF8A2A)
excluded.heart: hearts / lives: generic (art §2.2 #21, the §7.3 excluded families)
excluded.medal: gold / silver / bronze rank medals and rows: generic genre props (art §2.2 #21)
excluded.ice: the Freeze booster's ice and frost: semantic ice colours, generic
excluded.fx-multicolour: confetti / fireworks / sparkles / rainbow and violet trails / star trails: generic celebration palettes (board trails are LOW risk, art §2.2 #19; kept)
excluded.board-mechanics: board ink/ground, marked red, bump badge, hint green, the vignette/bump curves: the board is kept by ruling (art §2.2 #20)
excluded.board-skin: board obstacle skins drawn in code or by gen_board.py (tape, door, lock, key, pipe, box, counter, elevator, corner, shards): R7 BOARD-UI RESKINS them (new shapes and colours), so a remap would be thrown away; the hue family and a reference mapping are recorded
excluded.logo: the win/Loading logo parts: R6 LOGO restyles them (LG-1) in gen_icons.py
excluded.owned-svg: SVG art another package REDRAWS (R7: unlock icons, tutorial hand, pointers, pageBgPattern; R2: avatars)
excluded.not-shipped: a generator constant no shipped manifest id bakes (spike / comparison-only / superseded / removed art)
excluded.debug-ui: developer screens reachable only through -pc launch arguments (SoundBoard, SocialLab, DebugOverlay, DebugPlaceholder): their own tool colours, not player-visible, not in the capture list
excluded.non-colour: a hex token that is not a colour (an RNG seed)

explicit.why: indigo-violet in a purple context (purple button / plate, Sky Jump purple panel, the purple offer card)
indigo navy between blue and violet (OK hue 276-284) outside any purple context: a navy of the blue chrome

post_apply_check.note: after A5, a literal (or a captured pixel) in the old blue window must belong to an allowed family (ice, silver medal, fx, board, owner art, …)

edits.note: channel triple 0xRR/255 …: write the new channels
